MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk microSD card feels useful as spare storage because I have repeatedly bought memory cards and already have adapters, a reader, and cases to use with them.",
    "The basic Fire TV Stick offers a plausible new use for my existing television: streaming alongside the DVD player I recently bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 4K streaming devices offer little extra value for my 720p television, while the basic streaming stick already meets the need I can see.",
    "The Echo speakers and smart plug assume I want voice control, but buying a Fire tablet and practical power strips does not mean I want home automation.",
    "The earbuds, portable speaker, and Wi-Fi extender address needs I have not shown: personal audio, portable listening, or a coverage problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as broad interest in Amazon devices, even when those devices serve very different purposes.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as interest in popular gadgets generally, rather than accessories that solve a particular storage, mounting, charging, or photography need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated memory-card purchases, together with a reader and storage cases, show an ongoing storage need more clearly than a single device purchase does.",
    "The equipment I already own matters: my television is 720p, and accessories need to fit the devices and connections I actually use.",
    "My recent lens-cap purchase and repeated tripod purchases suggest continued interest in practical photography accessories."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my storage and television needs but stretched my device purchases into an unsupported interest in smart-home and audio gadgets."
}
